meta.title: The Story of Pokémon: the real history, as a 3D film
meta.description: How Pokémon was made and how it grew, from Satoshi Tajiri's bug hunts in 1970s Machida and the Game Boy link cable to Red and Green, Pokémania, Pokémon GO and thirty years. A cinematic 3D film with every line sourced.
meta.chapterDescription: {summary} Chapter {numeral} of The Story of Pokémon, the real history of the franchise as a 3D film, with every line sourced.

exploreEveryBody: The Pokémon Timeline: the games, anime, films and cards, date by date.
worldOwnBody: The History of the Pokémon World, as the games themselves tell it.
tagsHelp: Untagged lines are dated records. <said>In their words</said>: what a creator said in an interview. <reported>Reported</reported>: from the press or a biography. <retold>As it's told</retold>: a story told in more than one version.
people: People appear only as silhouettes and the things they used. No real photographs, screenshots, logos or box art are shown: every scene is built in 3D for this film.
music: Music: an original score written for this film, one theme arranged six ways, played with the MuseScore General sound font (MIT; its strings from VSCO 2 Community Edition, CC0). The ambience and effects are made in the browser (credits). The Pokémon figures are built from Pokémon HOME renders served by PokéAPI.
